review_basis: All eleven actual GitHub Actions Chromium PNGs were opened and semantically read at player height with immutable player/contact metadata. No source code, test result, pixel metric or capture filename was used to infer the findings.
review_focus: eye-height compositional clearance and motion readability

frames.what_is_visible: A first-person Dispatch roof opener: the permit threshold sits ahead behind black/orange stepped bands; brown surrounding facades and clean blue atmosphere fill the upper field.
what_looks_bad: The frame remains a narrow obstacle corridor. Broad bare roof, slab parapets and striped steps lead to a small buried objective rather than a strong industrial vista.
placeholder_signals: Textured cuboid roofs, black rails and thin oxide strips carry nearly all form.
repetition: Roof seams, step edges and orange strips use repeated spacing and alignment.
unconvincing_elements: The walls give no readable service function or connection to a visible lower harbour.
frames.dead_zone_assessment: The foreground roof has no active detail and the view through the route is blocked, so the layered harbour world is absent.
missing: A player-visible foreground, purposeful playable structure, adjacent/lower industrial layer, distant landmark and atmospheric depth in the requested region.
replace: Replace repeated black/orange bars and texture-wrapped wall planes with fewer constructed, visibly supported assemblies.
move: Move capture forward only after the requested grounded support is reached; preserve this frame as its actual region.
add: Add a clear supporting frame, service/wiring detail and an open lateral sight-line toward rail/harbour/industrial skyline.
remove: Remove eye-level foreground bars and redundant repeated nosings that block landing/route reads.

strengths: Real pointer-locked player input, camera direction, rendered-frame count and actual support contacts are now recorded.
Wide east/west input is genuinely distinct from the forward view, even though it exposes insufficient world depth.
defects: Keep thick rails/steps below the eye line and avoid geometry that hides the landing during speed or air control.
Eight requested destination frames are navigation misses; the route resets before Boiler Court, Control Bridge and Sunline.
Dispatch and Intake remain dominated by repeated black/orange bars, bare roof planes and monolithic brown facades.
priority_fixes: Keep thick rails/steps below the eye line and avoid geometry that hides the landing during speed or air control.
After each concrete repair, recapture with a bounded per-phase timeout and inspect a fresh immutable run; no old review survives the art/geometry change.

approval.reason: All category scores are below the 7.5 floor or zero for navigation misses. Dead zones, placeholder construction and an incomplete route make approval impossible.
